messages:
Alex: Heads-up — saw a double charge on session 34f2 when the shard lease moved mid-stream. Streaming tokens + a toolcall were both billed.
Maya: Oof. trace id?
Alex: trace=trc-2026-07-12-9fc; quick log snippet: 
```
[shard-12] lease_change: old_owner=redwood-dedicated-3 new_owner=redwood-burst-1 at seq=1024
[stream] seq 1020-1050 tokens emitted; toolcall invoked at seq=1033
```
Jun: Clarify: are we charging by owner_at_emission or owner_at_final_ack? That settles the logic.
Priya: Today billing is owner@confirm (final ack). We don't have provisional crediting for streams+toolcalls, so ownership flips can cause double-charge.
Alex: Proposal: chunk-level attribution. Tag each emitted chunk with origin_session_id + origin_owner. Charge origin_owner by default. If final_ack comes from a different owner and claims the chunk, mark for reconcile (refund/provisional adjust).
Maya: Edge: client truncation / early EOF — we sometimes bill full chunk even if client disconnects mid-chunk. Need truncation semantics too.
Jun: Perf note — tagging every token is heavy. Can we do chunk-boundary tags only (start_seq, end_seq, session_id)? Much less telemetry.
Priya: Chunk-level sounds good. Also need to emit lease_owner and session_id on billing telemetry so reconciliation jobs can run.
Alex: Pseudocode idea: 
```
emit_chunk(chunk): attach {session_id, origin_owner, seq_start, seq_end} to chunk_event
on_confirm(ack): if ack.claims_chunk && ack.owner != chunk_event.origin_owner:
  enqueue_reconcile(chunk_event, ack.owner)
else:
  charge(chunk_event.origin_owner)
```
Maya: Another gotcha — toolcalls. We call external tool at seq 1033; toolcall result attached to the stream chunk. If toolcall triggers additional token emission under new owner, attribution gets messy.
Jun: Could we treat toolcalls as atomic: toolcall tokens always billed to the session owner that initiated the toolcall, regardless of lease move? That simplifies billing but maybe violates capacity isolation.
Priya: That would be easiest from billing POV, but for Dedicated vs Burst we need to honor capacity billing. Maybe provisional: charge initiator immediately but reconcile if final owner claims capacity.
ops-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/token-attrib-2026 -> CI passed, awaiting merge.
Alex: I'll open a PR that implements chunk-level tags + a reconcile worker. @Jun can you run perf bench on seq length distribution 1/64/512/4096?
Jun: Yep, will run bench and measure overhead. Expect ~1-3% depending on event payload.
Priya: I'll draft a reconcile job spec and the billing-side acceptance tests (provisional -> final). Need telemetry fields: session_id, origin_owner, lease_owner_on_ack, seq_range.
Maya: UX ask: Console should surface "provisional charges" per session with a link to traces and reconcile status. That'll cut down Ops tickets.
Alex: Plan = PR + perf bench + reconcile job + console flag. Action items: Alex -> PR, Jun -> perf, Priya -> billing spec, Maya -> console mockups. Thanks :thumbsup:
